description: This file defines a ViewModel class for enabling two-factor authentication via an authenticator app in an ASP.NET Core web application. It contains properties for verification code, shared key, and authenticator URI, with data annotations for validation and display.

classes.name: EnableAuthenticatorViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel used to facilitate enabling an authenticator app, containing properties for verification code, shared key, and authenticator URI, with validation attributes.
